body.statement: For the balanced two-arm binary finite-population minimax problem with unit contrast \(Y_i(1)-Y_i(0)\), the second-order minimax deficit constant, in the normalization used by the shifted-binomial experiment, is \(-4^{1/3}a_1'\).

attestation.note: Stable arXiv handle and theorem locator; the normalization is the one stated in the frozen target.
